name: maison-demo
description: From UX to AX: one set of Strapi MCP tools serving a LINE app, the customer's concierge and staff, with LINE confirmations sent by Strapi.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix strapi && npm install --prefix liff && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/line-mode.mjs require-local && concurrently -k -n strapi,app -c magenta,green "npm run develop --prefix strapi" "npm run dev --prefix liff"
scripts.dev:offline: node scripts/line-mode.mjs require-local && concurrently -k -n line,strapi,app -c yellow,magenta,green "npm run line:stand-in" "AI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible AI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 AI_MODEL=qwen3-14b-32k AI_CHAT_MODEL=qwen3-14b-32k AI_CHAT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 MAISON_LINE_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4010 npm run develop --prefix strapi" "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY= npm run dev --prefix liff"
scripts.dev:app: node scripts/line-mode.mjs require-local && npm run dev --prefix liff
scripts.test: npm test --prefix liff && npm test --prefix strapi/src/plugins/maison && node strapi/scripts/share-strapi-utils.mjs --check && node --test scripts/line-mode.test.mjs scripts/line-tunnel.test.mjs scripts/line-stand-in.test.mjs scripts/maison-setup.test.mjs scripts/home-page-starting-text.test.mjs liff/scripts/line-qr.test.mjs liff/scripts/mock-line-verify.test.mjs
